blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Manny Luis Bueno edged Matt Matthew Zamora by just one pin to capture the championship in the Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) Bowling Shootout tournament on Sunday, October 18, at the SM Bowling Center of SM Seaside City in Cebu City. Bueno tallied 833 pinfalls in the four-game series and narrowly beat Zamora, who finished with 832. Bueno’s victory carried added significance as the veteran bowler, 75, made his return to the sport following a successful heart bypass operation previously.
